scripts.skills:check: npm run check:codebase && npm run check:schema && npm run check:security && npm run check:ui && npm run check:boundaries
scripts.check:codebase: echo "📍 Skill 1: 分析代码所有权..." && node tools/scripts/check-codebase.js
scripts.check:schema: echo "📍 Skill 2: 验证数据结构..." && node tools/scripts/check-schema.js
scripts.check:refactor: echo "📍 Skill 3: 检查重构风险..." && node tools/scripts/check-refactor.js
scripts.check:duplicates: echo "📍 Skill 4: 检测重复页面..." && node tools/scripts/check-duplicates.js
scripts.check:encoding: echo "📍 Skill 5: 检查字符编码..." && node tools/scripts/check-encoding.js
scripts.check:security: echo "[Skill 6] Security check..." && eslint eslint.config.js tools/scripts/check-security.js js/payment-password.js js/cloudbase.js && node tools/scripts/check-security.js
scripts.check:ui: echo "[Skill 7] UI consistency check..." && stylelint "css/**/*.css" "admin/css/**/*.css" || echo "Stylelint issues found; continue report." && node tools/scripts/check-ui.js
scripts.check:boundaries: echo "[Skill 8] Architecture boundaries..." && depcruise js admin/js --exclude "^node_modules|^tmp|^test-results"
scripts.report:all: npm run check:codebase && npm run check:schema && npm run check:refactor && npm run check:duplicates && npm run check:encoding && npm run check:security && npm run check:ui && npm run check:boundaries
